Name: Community Wednesdays (PT-BR)
Author: Noonsaliwah
Description:
[b][size=4]While this standalone version continues to work, the Brazilian Portuguese translation is now part of the original mod; so you can download the original mod for the latest updates/bugfixes.[/size][/b]


This is a translation of the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16966]Community Wednesdays[/url], into Brazilian Portuguese.
Translator: [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/185613369-ericofurtado/]ericofurtado

[/url]Please let us know if you spot any typos!



The mod adds short scenes in the Community Centre which play every Wednesday. The Community Centre must be completed, and then you can enter any time of day on a Wednesday to view a fun scene.
There are about 20 scenes total.

Use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change the layout of the scenes if you are using a mod which changes the layout of the community centre (Stardew Valley Expanded or LemurKat's Community Centre Reimagined).

Downloads.Description: Fixes an issue with events appearing on Joja route
